nectar.name: Hive Nectar
nectar.lore: Sweet and thick. The Nectar Offering in the Hive Court wants it.

brood_key.name: Brood Key
brood_key.lore: Opens the waxen door to the Monarch Brood Chamber.

waves.say: The cocoons split. Chitin clicks in the dark.

onDone.text: The brood falls still. A bottle of Hive Nectar sits in the wax.
The wax wall melts back. A brood tunnel runs on toward a webbed ravine.
Silk spools out across the pit. The span is down.

onStep.text: The winch clicks. The second lever.

mechanics.jam: The winch is stuck. The west lever first.

onOpen.text: The nectar spreads into the wax and a sweet wall melts away in the south.

mechanics.hint: A basin of honey comb, dry, waiting for nectar.
mechanics.verb: pours the Nectar into the basin and the wax wall melts.

onOpen.text: The waxen door to the Monarch Brood Chamber parts.

mechanics.hint: A waxen door sealed with amber, a keyhole shaped like a mandible.
mechanics.verb: turns the Brood Key and the waxen door parts.

encounters.say: Silk veils hang from the ceiling. Something is pulling them tight.
The court hums. A basin of dry comb waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Monarch
bosses.intro: The Monarch unfolds from its throne of comb. Break the three honey wards on the pillars to crack its chitin.
bosses.deathText: The Monarch curls up and the hive goes silent.

shield.breakText: The wards crack! The Monarch is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Monarch calls its servants.

completion.intro: The Monarch's Hive. Open the brood tunnel, lower the silk span, and carry nectar to the court.
completion.message: The hum fades. The hive closes shortly.
